title: Implement secure data storage and role-based access control with Admin and Viewer roles

requirements.text: Add a 'role' field to the UserProfile data structure in backend/main.mo with two possible values: 'admin' and 'viewer', defaulting new users to 'viewer' role

quotes:
Implement role-based access:

Admin: Can Add/Edit Production Data
Viewer: Can only view dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: UserProfile type includes a role field of type Text with values 'admin' or 'viewer'
New user profiles are created with role set to 'viewer' by default
The role field is persisted in stable storage along with other user profile data

requirements.text: Update all backend mutation functions (addProductionRecord, addDispatchRecord, createDailyProductionReport, updateDailyProductionReport, deleteDailyProductionReport) to check that the caller has 'admin' role before allowing the operation, returning an error if the caller has 'viewer' role

quotes:
Admin: Can Add/Edit Production Data
Viewer: Can only view dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: All data modification operations verify caller role is 'admin' before execution
Operations return a descriptive error message when attempted by 'viewer' role users
Query operations (getAllProductionRecords, getAllDispatchRecords, getAllDailyProductionReports, etc.) remain accessible to both admin and viewer roles

requirements.text: Create a backend query function 'getCallerRole' that returns the role ('admin' or 'viewer') of the authenticated caller, returning null if no profile exists

quotes:
Implement role-based access:

Admin: Can Add/Edit Production Data
Viewer: Can only view dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Function returns 'admin' or 'viewer' for users with existing profiles
Function returns null for users without profiles
Function is accessible to all authenticated users

requirements.text: Create a custom React hook 'useGetCallerRole' at frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerRole.ts that fetches the current user's role using the getCallerRole backend function

quotes:
Implement role-based access:

Admin: Can Add/Edit Production Data
Viewer: Can only view dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Hook uses React Query to fetch caller role with appropriate caching
Hook returns loading state, role data ('admin' | 'viewer' | null), and error state
Hook is enabled only when actor is initialized

requirements.text: Update the AuthGuard component at frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx to check caller role and conditionally render components: show full application to admin users, show read-only dashboard access to viewer users, and show access denied to unauthenticated users

quotes:
Admin: Can Add/Edit Production Data
Viewer: Can only view dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Admin users can access all routes and features
Viewer users can only access dashboard routes (/production-dashboard, /dashboard) and are redirected or blocked from data entry routes
Unauthenticated users see the access denied screen
Loading states are displayed while role is being fetched

requirements.text: Update the Layout component navigation menu at frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx to conditionally display menu items based on user role: show all navigation items to admin users, show only dashboard links to viewer users

quotes:
Admin: Can Add/Edit Production Data
Viewer: Can only view dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Admin users see all navigation menu items (Dashboard, Production Dashboard, Production Entry, Production History, Dispatch Tracking, Work in Hand, Daily Reports)
Viewer users see only Dashboard and Production Dashboard menu items
Navigation menu updates reactively when user role changes

requirements.text: Hide or disable all data entry forms and edit/delete buttons on frontend pages for viewer users: disable DailyProductionReportForm, ProductionEntryPage form, DispatchEntryForm, and edit/delete actions in all tables

quotes:
Admin: Can Add/Edit Production Data
Viewer: Can only view dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Forms and action buttons are hidden or disabled when caller role is 'viewer'
Dashboard and table views remain fully visible and functional for viewer users
Admin users continue to see and interact with all forms and actions
UI clearly indicates read-only status for viewer users where appropriate

requirements.text: Add a backend function 'updateUserRole' that allows an existing admin to change another user's role between 'admin' and 'viewer', verifying that the caller has admin privileges before allowing the operation

quotes:
Implement role-based access:

Admin: Can Add/Edit Production Data
Viewer: Can only view dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Function accepts a Principal (user identifier) and new role value as parameters
Function verifies caller is an admin before allowing role changes
Function updates the target user's role in stable storage
Function returns success confirmation or descriptive error message

requirements.text: Verify that all production data (ProductionRecord, DispatchRecord, DailyProductionReport, UserProfile) is stored in backend stable variables in backend/main.mo to ensure persistence across canister upgrades

quotes: Ensure that all production data is securely stored in the internal database

acceptanceCriteria: All data structures use stable storage declarations (stable var)
Data persists across canister upgrades without loss
No production data is stored in ephemeral memory or external databases

constraints: All production data must remain in the Motoko backend stable storage; do not introduce external databases
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Role-based access must not break existing admin functionality
Query operations must remain accessible to both admin and viewer roles
nonGoals: Implementing user registration or invitation system
Adding email notifications for role changes
Creating a separate admin panel for user management UI
Implementing audit logging for role changes
Creating custom authentication beyond Internet Identity
